name: What steps are involved in a professional kitchen cabinet repair project?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a professional kitchen cabinet repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional kitchen cabinet repair project typically begins with an initial assessment of the damage and a detailed estimate. Once approved, the contractor will prepare the work area to protect surrounding surfaces. The repair process involves cleaning the damaged area, making necessary structural reinforcements, applying fillers or patches, sanding, and then finishing with paint, stain, or veneer application to match the existing cabinets. Finally, hardware is reinstalled or replaced, and a thorough clean-up is performed, followed by a final inspection with the homeowner to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Steps include damage assessment, estimate, work area preparation, structural repair, patching, sanding, finishing (paint/stain/veneer), hardware reinstallation, and final inspection.
